Section One: Explaining Names. This is divided into two parts: 1. Explaining the names of the Five Phases; 2. Discussing the names of the Stems and Branches.

Mù (Wood) occupies the position of Shàoyáng (Lesser Yang);

Huǒ (Fire) occupies the position of Dàyáng (Greater Yang);
